entities.name: Giva Province
entities.description: One of the Northern Provinces during the Dark Age of Terisiare, frozen and depopulated at the start of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Northern Provinces
entities.description: Loose farmsteads and city-states after the old cities fell apart.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Nation that survived into the Dark Age.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Built a mage tower on his farmstead in Giva.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Born and raised briefly on the farm.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Hardy folk who later resettled the land.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Nation that later included the land.

events.summary: The land of Jarsyl's farmstead failed in the cold and became swampy; Jodah's family abandoned it.
events.quote: Jodah was born and spent his first few years on the farm, fallen fallow, until his family had to abandon it completely to the cold.

events.summary: Giva Province froze over and was depopulated at the start of the Ice Age.
events.quote: was frozen over and depopulated during the Start of the Ice Age

events.summary: The land was later resettled by Kjeldorans and included in New Argive after the Thaw.
events.quote: would later be re-settled by the hardy Kjeldorans
